description: Search the product catalog (UCP catalog.search). Put the destination country in catalog.context.address_country for final prices in local currency. Optional vehicle filter: catalog.filters.vehicle = {make, model, year}.

country.description: Destination country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (e.g. AT). Needed for final prices; without it prices are EUR estimates.
